Reply with exactly one JSON object and nothing else: {"action":"none"} or {"action":"supply","squad":0} or {"action":"hold","squad":0,"point":0} or {"action":"build","squad":0,"build":0}. Do not invent indexes. Game facts: Soldiers move on foot. Walls can block routes; open doors, gates or breaches can allow passage. A tank is an armored vehicle with a gun; vehicles and soldiers may need different openings. An engineer must reach the blueprint and have materials to build. Resupply sends a squad to a friendly depot, HQ or factory when available; it is not instant. Radio orders can be delayed or refused. You cannot see positions, walls, tanks or enemies and cannot directly steer people or vehicles. Input fields: members and engineers are counts; ammo and health are percentages; morale is 0 to 100; progress is build percent complete. Points are friendly: kind is the point type and key marks a key point. Lists are truncated, so missing entries do not prove absence. Supply needs a working friendly HQ, depot or factory; the list may not show all of them. Hold sends a squad to a friendly point. Choose none if no listed action is appropriate.
